messages:
anya (Partnerships): Quick heads-up — Datadog APM + OpenTelemetry end-to-end plan for model-level traces and a marketplace tile. Want to scope traces, metrics, dashboard template, and announcement assets. Can we sync tomorrow 11:00am PT?

sam (obs-eng): yes, obs-eng can own the trace schema and dashboard layout. Recommend model-level spans: `request.receive`, `model.load`, `model.infer`, `kv.cache.hit/miss`, and per-GPU shard spans. Keep span attributes lightweight (model.version, seq_len, batch_size, device). :+1:

li (infra): runtime already has an OTLP exporter behind a feature flag. I'll flip a branch and add a small config snippet for customers and dedicated/private deployments. example config:
```yaml
otel:
  service.name: redwood.inference
  exporters:
    otlp:
      endpoint: https://otlp.datadoghq.com:4317
      headers:
        DD-API-KEY: ${DD_API_KEY}
  resources:
    attributes:
      deployment.environment: production
```
We should also document certs/KMS guidance for Private installs.

maria (product): Marketplace needs the dashboard PNG + a short blurb and 3 bullet points about observability value prop. Timeline: listing drafts due EOD next Thursday for marketplace review (so ~10 business days). Marketing will want a screenshot that highlights model-level latency distribution and per-shard GPU utilization.

nvidia-rep (partner): we can surface DCGM GPU metrics into Datadog; we'll map GPU metrics -> Datadog metric names and share a panel bundle. Will send mapping spreadsheet by Tue. Also happy to provide an official panel JSON we can adapt.

sam (obs-eng): for dashboard template I'm going to build: 1) Model latency waterfall (by span), 2) Heatmap of batch_size vs latency, 3) Per-GPU utilization and memory, 4) Error/retry split, 5) Token throughput (per-second). I'll export as Datadog dashboard JSON and attach. Suggest we keep template parameterized by `service.name` and `model.version`.

anya (Partnerships): Nice. Who owns the public docs + sample code snippet for customers? We need a short quickstart showing "Datadog + Redwood traces in 5 min" for the marketplace tile.

li (infra): infra will own the runtime change and provide a minimal SDK snippet for customers. Quickstart 5-min example (pseudo):
```python
from redwood_runtime import Tracer
tracer = Tracer(os.environ['REDWOOD_OTEL'])
with tracer.span('model.infer'):
    out = runtime.generate(prompt)
```
And env var: `DD_API_KEY` for datadog.

maria (product): Marketing will draft the blurb. For the marketplace tile we need: 1) screenshot, 2) 50–100 word description, 3) 3 quickstart steps, 4) contact link. I'll pick a PM reviewer (cc @anya).

datadog-bot: Datadog docs: Unified OTLP ingestion: https://docs.datadoghq.com/tracing/otlp/ :eyes:

anya (Partnerships): Action items: 
- Anya: schedule 11am PT sync (calendar invite sent) :calendar:
- Sam: build initial Datadog dashboard JSON and post to this thread by Tue EOD
- Li: land runtime OTLP flag + example config PR by Wed
- Nvidia-rep: share DCGM->Datadog mapping spreadsheet by Tue
- Maria: draft marketplace copy and required assets checklist by Fri

sam (obs-eng): will also add an example trace span payload for the SDK so teams can wire up span tagging for model.version and rollout.flag. I'll post the sample trace JSON here after the dashboard draft.

li (infra): note: for Private deployments we need to include instructions to route OTLP to customer's Datadog endpoint or via a proxy in their VPC. I'll add a short runbook.

nvidia-rep (partner): sending initial panels + mapping tomorrow morning. Happy to join the sync if helpful.

anya (Partnerships): Perfect — aim to have assets ready for internal review next Friday so Marketplace can start the listing the week after. Thanks all. :rocket:

sam (obs-eng): :thumbsup:

maria (product): :eyes:
